guide.summary: A virus that infects only Sprinters and makes new copies of itself inside them.
guide.biology: Real viruses that infect bacteria, called phages, each attack only certain kinds of bacteria and burst them to release new copies.
guide.rules: Spreads through water, gel and sediment as viral units, each holding 0.01 carbon. Each tick a Sprinter is infected with chance 1 − exp(−0.05 × units in its cell × 0.1), and infection uses up one whole unit; less than one unit cannot infect. An infected Sprinter still feeds but cannot divide or heal. After 20 seconds it bursts: up to 40% of its body becomes new units, and the rest, with all its minerals, becomes detritus. Loose units decay by 1% per second into detritus. Without Sprinters it cannot multiply. Fine membranes block it; small gates pass half as much.
guide.example: Add a little Pinphage to a dish of Sprinters and Crumbsmiths and watch which population drops.
